content.body:
The Persona Select screen allows you to view detailed information on each of your game personas and to select one to play.
Personas are listed by country and branch of military service. When you select a persona, you will see information about that persona on the right, including rank, progress to the next rank, and the current Brigade Attachment, which is the last brigade you played that persona in.
To play a persona, select it with the mouse and click the Select Brigade button on the bottom right of the screen. You can also double click the persona to automatically advance to the next screen. If your selected persona is not attached to a brigade, you will be taken to the Brigade Roster, otherwise you will go directly to your Brigade HQ.
The game restricts players from quickly switching between Axis and Allied sides. Personas that are not available to you due to recently playing for one side of the conflict will be listed "On Leave". These personas will become available once you have been logged out of the game for several hours. Personas that are available for play will be listed as "Active Duty".
content.title: Persona Selection
